'''Tactical Report Assessment DNT-2238.553b''' was a document prepared by [[Assessor 34372]],<ref name="TORWEB">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190503|text=Dantooine Tactical Report|int=Dantooine Tactical Report}}</ref> an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="TORNEWSPAGE2">{{TORweb|url=info/news?page=2|text=News, Updates, Developer Blogs, Page 2|quote=As war escalates throughout the galaxy, an agent of the Empire takes notice of a rare opportunity on Dantooine&hellip;|oldversion=20190907181704}}</ref> on using the [[Nova Blades]], a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], to [[Dantooine Incursion|destabilize]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], which was allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TORWEB" />
